name: The Name of the Beast
label: Quest
description: The Name of the Beast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is only one way to harm the demon lord and his minions. A weapon of power must be forged bearing his true name.
When such a weapon is forged, the demon and all under his command are vulnerable.
A lesser deity resides in Azshara: Lord Arkkoroc. You must seek him out but be warned, his minions will stop at nothing to destroy you if you are discovered.
Undoubtedly, you will have to pay a price for such information.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perhaps the one can assist you with this information; but first, you must assist the one.
